$comment: npm-audit equivalent of .trivyignore, consumed by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs (the blocking Security Scan step). Every entry needs an advisory id, the tree it applies to (scope = npm prefix, or '*'), a reason, and an added date. Review quarterly alongside .trivyignore; remove entries as soon as an in-range fix ships.

exceptions.reason: brace-expansion DoS (CVE-2026-14257) is fixed only in 5.0.8; the mobile tree receives 1.1.16/2.1.2 via minimatch inside @expo/cli, npm publishes no 1.x/2.x backport as of 2026-07-25, and a forced override to 5.x is API-incompatible (v5 exports named {expand}, v1/v2 consumers require a bare function — verified to break at runtime). The only npm-offered fix is the breaking expo@57 major; the mobile app is on hold pending that migration. Glob expansion here processes repo file paths at build time, never untrusted input.
